# Context Hash Grants
> Approval leases bound to grant context — every approval seals content hash + context hash, Ed25519-signed and hash-chained.

Approval ceremony: assemble an action + full context envelope, compute a SHA-256 context hash over canonical JSON, sign offline with the CWI Ed25519 key, publish hash-chained. Verify tab recomputes both hashes: VERIFIED / TAMPERED / EXPIRED. Additive only — existing grants are never invalidated.

## Live
- App: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-context-grants/
- Try it: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-context-grants/?grant=grt_01M2N6393WDXF05J7PRNNP28Y0

## Features
- Pure-JS SHA-256 (bit-identical browser + Node)
- Offline Ed25519 signing (key off-repo)
- Hash-chained grant registry
- ?grant=<id> deep links
- verify-grant.js zero-trust Node verifier
- cwi.context-grant/1.0 schema
- 26/26 tests

## Machine-readable
- verify_grant: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-context-grants/?grant=grt_01M2N6393WDXF05J7PRNNP28Y0
- registry: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-context-grants/grants/index.json
- public_key: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-context-grants/keys/ed25519.pub

## Honest limits
A grant binds the recorded context, not the universe. VERIFIED proves this exact content in this exact context was approved before expiry — not that the action was wise.
